sentences.en: TAMARA: Shall we go through the notes we've made from our research into loneliness now, Dev?
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 我们现在来梳理一下我们针对孤独感所做的研究笔记吧，Dev？

sentences.en: DEV: OK, Tamara
sentences.zh: DEV: 好的，Tamara。

sentences.en: It's been a real eye -opener
sentences.zh: 这真是一次令人眼界大开的经历。

sentences.en: I had no idea that loneliness has been increasing steadily for the last 20 years
sentences.zh: 我完全没想到，过去20年来孤独感一直在稳步上升。

sentences.en: TAMARA: I know
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 我知道。

sentences.en: And it's the same all over the world
sentences.zh: 而且全世界都是如此。

sentences.en: The downside of a modern lifestyle, I guess
sentences.zh: 我想，这大概是现代生活方式带来的负面影响吧。

sentences.en: DEV: Did you come to any conclusions about what the reasons for the increase are?
sentences.zh: DEV: 你有没有得出关于这种增长原因的任何结论？

sentences.en: TAMARA: Well, I'd assumed it was mainly an issue for the elderly, but in fact it's something which affects young people just as much
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 嗯，我原本以为这主要是个老年人的问题，但实际上它对年轻人的影响同样严重。

sentences.en: DEV: So nothing really to do with longer lifespans
sentences.zh: DEV: 所以这跟寿命延长其实没什么关系。

sentences.en: What about social media?
sentences.zh: 那社交媒体呢？

sentences.en: In my case, far from making me feel isolated, it actually does the opposite. it?
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，它非但没有让我感到孤立，反而起到了相反的作用，是吗？

sentences.en: TAMARA: It definitely does more good than harm
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 它带来的益处显然远大于害处。

sentences.en: I'd say loneliness has a lot to do with the way cities are designed
sentences.zh: 我认为，孤独感与城市的设计方式有很大关系。

sentences.en: People living in high flats with not much opportunity to speak to their neighbours
sentences.zh: 住在高层公寓里的人们几乎没有机会与邻居交谈。

sentences.en: DEV: I think you right
sentences.zh: DEV: 我觉得你说得对。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Another possible reason is that people are having fewer children and don live in large extended family groups
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 另一个可能的原因是，人们的生育数量减少了，也不再生活在庞大的扩展式家庭中。

sentences.en: DEV: But in this country anyway, that all changed decades ago
sentences.zh: DEV: 但至少在我们这个国家，这种情况几十年前就已改变了。

sentences.en: And yet loneliness is a more recent problem
sentences.zh: 然而孤独感却是一个更为近期才出现的问题。

sentences.en: TAMARA: I suppose so
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 我想确实如此。

sentences.en: A more plausible explanation is that people are having to move around for work and often end up living miles away from their family and friends
sentences.zh: 一个更可信的解释是，人们因工作需要四处奔波，结果常常住在离家人和朋友数英里远的地方。

sentences.en: DEV: That's true
sentences.zh: DEV: 没错。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Looking at the studies on health risks and loneliness, there are claims that loneliness has as much impact as smoking 15 cigarettes a day
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 查阅关于孤独感与健康风险的研究，有观点称孤独感对健康的影响相当于每天抽15支烟。

sentences.en: DEV: Or similar to the risks caused by obesity
sentences.zh: DEV: 或者与肥胖引发的风险相似。

sentences.en: But I'm not sure there's enough evidence for some of these claims
sentences.zh: 但我并不确定这些说法是否有足够证据支持。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Well, what about that one in Finland, which showed that loneliness increased the risk of cancer by about 10%?
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 那么芬兰那项研究呢？它表明孤独感使患癌症的风险增加了约10%。

sentences.en: And those findings have been supported by other studies too
sentences.zh: 而且这些发现也得到了其他研究的支持。

sentences.en: DEV: You're right about that one
sentences.zh: DEV: 关于那项研究，你说得对。

sentences.en: I was actually thinking of the studies on dementia
sentences.zh: 我实际上想到的是有关痴呆症的研究。

sentences.en: Some found no association between loneliness and dementia, and others found the opposite
sentences.zh: 其中一些研究未发现孤独感与痴呆症之间存在关联，而另一些研究则得出了相反结论。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Not exactly reliable, then
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 这样看来，其可靠性就不太高了。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of research on cardiovascular disease and whether loneliness contributes to that
sentences.zh: 目前已有大量针对心血管疾病的研究，探讨孤独感是否对其有所影响。

sentences.en: DEV: Yes, I read that it was hard to reach a judgment, as the definition of loneliness varied quite a lot, and the responses from participants were too subjective
sentences.zh: DEV: 是的，我读到过，由于‘孤独感’的定义差异很大，且参与者反馈过于主观，因此很难得出明确结论。

sentences.en: But there's no doubt that loneliness contributes to a weakened immune system
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，孤独感会导致免疫系统功能减弱。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Unquestionably
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 这一点毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: The data on that is sound
sentences.zh: 相关数据是可靠的。

sentences.en: DEV: What did you think about the evolutionary theory of loneliness?
sentences.zh: DEV: 你对孤独感的进化理论怎么看？

sentences.en: TAMARA: Well I thought the idea that loneliness evolved because it motivated people to be with other people is quite convincing
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 嗯，我认为‘孤独感之所以进化而来，是因为它能促使人们与他人相伴’这一观点颇具说服力。

sentences.en: Survival often depended on group cooperation
sentences.zh: 生存往往依赖于群体协作。

sentences.en: DEV: But I don think there is enough evidence to claim that there must be a group of neurons in our brains which influence social behaviour by making us feel bad when we're alone
sentences.zh: DEV: 但我认为，尚无足够证据断言：我们大脑中必然存在一组神经元，通过让我们独处时感到不适来影响社交行为。

sentences.en: TAMARA: There are a few studies which support the theory, but not conclusively enough
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 有一些研究支持这一理论，但证据尚不充分。

sentences.en: More evidence is needed
sentences.zh: 还需要更多证据。

sentences.en: DEV: And anyway, this theory's not really useful when it comes to solving the problem of loneliness today
sentences.zh: DEV: 而且，就当下解决孤独问题而言，这一理论实际上并无太大用处。

sentences.en: TAMARA: True
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 没错。

sentences.en: DEV: Should we look at the relationship between loneliness and mental health now?
sentences.zh: DEV: 我们现在是否该探讨一下孤独与心理健康之间的关系？

sentences.en: TAMARA: OK
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 好的。

sentences.en: So, loneliness and depression are clearly related and that's been recognised by various governments around the world
sentences.zh: 孤独与抑郁症之间显然存在关联，这一点已被世界各国政府所认可。

sentences.en: But unlike depression, loneliness has no recognised clinical form
sentences.zh: 但与抑郁症不同，孤独并未被认定为一种临床疾病。

sentences.en: DEV: There's no available diagnosis or effective treatment and that's not likely to change
sentences.zh: DEV: 目前既无明确的诊断标准，也无有效治疗方法，而且这种情况短期内不太可能改变。

sentences.en: TAMARA: I don't think so either I was thinking we should start our presentation with an example from our own experience I like to talk about how lonely I was when I started university being away from home for the first time and all that
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 我也不这么认为。我在想，我们是否该以自身经历的一个例子作为演讲的开场？我喜欢谈谈自己刚上大学时的孤独感——那是我第一次离家求学，诸如此类的经历。

sentences.en: DEV: Good idea
sentences.zh: DEV: 这主意不错。

sentences.en: Everyone will be able to relate to that although a lot of students were probably too embarrassed to admit to it
sentences.zh: 大家都会对此产生共鸣，尽管许多学生可能因羞于启齿而不敢承认。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Yeah
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 是啊。

sentences.en: We could discuss ways of dealing with loneliness as well, like just talking to strangers
sentences.zh: 我们还可以讨论一些应对孤独的方法，比如主动与陌生人交谈。

sentences.en: DEV: Loads of studies have shown that interactions with shop assistants and bar staff make people feel more optimistic and relaxed
sentences.zh: DEV: 大量研究表明，与商店店员、酒吧服务员等人的互动能让人们感到更乐观、更放松。

sentences.en: TAMARA: I don't know about that, but it must make people feel more connected with their community
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 这一点我倒不太确定，但它肯定能让人们感觉与所在社区的联系更紧密。

sentences.en: DEV: True, although you need to be a certain kind of person to be able to just strike up a conversation
sentences.zh: DEV: 的确如此，不过你得是某种特定性格的人，才容易主动开启对话。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Good point
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 说得对。

sentences.en: We should say something about solitude and how being alone and being lonely aren't the same thing
sentences.zh: 我们还应提及独处（solitude）的概念，并说明独处与孤独并非同一回事。

sentences.en: It's strange the way some people can't stand being by themselves while others love it
sentences.zh: 有些人在独处时如坐针毡，而另一些人却乐在其中，这种现象确实很奇特。

sentences.en: DEV: Yeah, the research shows a certain amount of solitude is beneficial for wellbeing, which I appreciate, but being alone isn't something I actually like
sentences.zh: DEV: 是的，研究表明一定程度的独处对身心健康有益，这一点我认同，但独处实际上并不是我喜欢的事情。

sentences.en: I'd never choose to go on holiday alone, for example
sentences.zh: 例如，我绝不会选择独自去度假。

sentences.en: TAMARA: Me neither
sentences.zh: TAMARA: 我也不会。

sentences.en: DEV: Well, let's not... you
sentences.zh: DEV: 好吧，我们先别……你
